creator: OutmodedElectronics
description: OutmodedElectronics 5E3 Tweed Deluxe full-rig captures, including speaker and Shure SM57 microphone. The selected Edge sounds use V1/V2/T settings of 7/0/8 with an A12Q speaker and 8/0/7 with a 12A125A speaker. V1 and V2 are the two channel volumes; T is Tone. Input and output references are both 11.5 dBu. No additional cabinet IR is required. These details come from the supplied filenames and NAM metadata; an exact public pack page was not found.
